// Generated from framework/contracts/author/src by `bun run contracts:generate`.
// Do not edit by hand.
import type {
  AgentHarness,
  AgentRuntimeEvent,
  Chat,
  ChatContribution,
  ChatTurnInput,
  HarnessInvokeOptions,
} from "./index";

import { HarnessType } from "./enums";

export const harnessInvokeOptions = (
  prompt: string,
  overrides: Omit<Partial<HarnessInvokeOptions>, "prompt" | "type"> = {}
): HarnessInvokeOptions => ({
  ...overrides,
  prompt,
  type: HarnessType.InvokeOptions,
});

export const collectHarnessEvents = async (
  harness: AgentHarness,
  options: HarnessInvokeOptions
): Promise<readonly AgentRuntimeEvent[]> => {
  let prompt: ((options: HarnessInvokeOptions) => AsyncIterable<AgentRuntimeEvent>) | undefined;
  let close: (() => Promise<void>) | undefined;
  const events: AgentRuntimeEvent[] = [];
  try {
    await harness.init({
      registerClose: (callback) => { close = callback; },
      // This helper exercises prompt collection only.
      registerCompaction: (callback) => {
        void callback;
      },
      registerConnect: () => {
        throw new Error("Prompt-only test harness must not connect");
      },
      registerProbe: (probe) => {
        void probe;
      },
      registerPrompt: (callback) => { prompt = callback; },
      setDefaultModel: (model) => {
        void model;
      },
    });
    if (prompt === undefined) {
      throw new Error(`Harness "${harness.name}" did not register a prompt callback`);
    }
    for await (const event of prompt(options)) {
      events.push(event);
    }
    return events;
  } finally {
    await close?.();
  }
};

// RFC 0009 surface-fixture-seam.md: a model-free scripted Chat runtime. A chat surface receives a
// `Chat` and drives it; this builds one whose `sendMessage` replays a fixed
// event script and records every turn input, so a Contract-tier test can assert
// how the surface used the runtime — no network, no model.
export interface ScriptedChat {
  readonly chat: Chat;
  readonly sentInputs: () => readonly ChatTurnInput[];
}

export const makeScriptedChat = (
  script: readonly AgentRuntimeEvent[] = [],
  options: { readonly initialSessionId?: string } = {}
): ScriptedChat => {
  const sent: ChatTurnInput[] = [];
  const chat: Chat = {
    initialSessionId: () => options.initialSessionId,
    listSessions: () => Promise.resolve([]),
    async *sendMessage(input: ChatTurnInput) {
      sent.push(input);
      for (const event of script) {
        yield event;
      }
    },
  };
  return { chat, sentInputs: () => sent };
};

// Run a chat surface's start/stop lifecycle against a scripted Chat and return
// the recorded turn inputs, so a test can drive the surface without a runtime.
export const driveChatSurface = async (
  surface: ChatContribution,
  scripted: ScriptedChat = makeScriptedChat()
): Promise<{ readonly sentInputs: readonly ChatTurnInput[] }> => {
  await surface.start(scripted.chat);
  await surface.stop();
  return { sentInputs: scripted.sentInputs() };
};

// Deep-equality fixture assertions need a stable projection: raw harness
// events carry per-run fields (ids, timestamps, full raw payloads) that would
// make every expectation flaky, so tests compare only payload/source/type.
export interface ProjectedEvent {
  readonly payload: AgentRuntimeEvent["payload"];
  readonly source: NonNullable<AgentRuntimeEvent["raw"]>["source"] | undefined;
  readonly type: AgentRuntimeEvent["type"];
}

export const projectEventForAssertion = (
  event: AgentRuntimeEvent
): ProjectedEvent => ({
  payload: event.payload,
  source: event.raw?.source,
  type: event.type,
});
